comment: Aggregated registry of inference services for the OpenCode fleet. Model inventory verified against gato-fleet proxy (supercat :8500) on 2026-08-13.

services.description: Fleet inference hub — NVIDIA GB10 Grace-Blackwell, vLLM in Docker. Primary chat + agent inference (Ornith-9B via vllm-text :8010).
Dual-GPU fleet node (RTX 6000 Ada + RTX 3080 Ti). Hosts embed/rerank/ctx-holder (bge-m3 :8016, bge-reranker-v2-m3 :8018, ctx-holder :8099) and voice stack.
Third fleet node. NOT currently advertising models via the gato-fleet proxy (2026-08-13) — entry retained for compatibility.
